checks.name: Low-arc aiming reaches targets with the exact visible jet speed and gravity; impossible shots remain out of range
Clicking a target stops movement, turns the actor and locks a clear reticle without auto-firing
Space starts closed-mouth anticipation; pause freezes the animation, jet and hit state
The water travels from the mouth before any hit is awarded
Real surface impact awards one hit, bends the target and shows a water flash, splash and +1
A full stream scores once, finishes in Idle and leaves no persistent hit effect
All three target models receive hits, and repeated fire input cannot stack a shot
Returning to movement interrupts the shot and prevents a delayed ghost hit
Grass, cottage obstruction and out-of-range aiming never award phantom target hits
Escape clears a target lock; grass clicks always resume walking without a mode switch
Touch target selection and the on-screen fire button work above a compact mobile panel
Repeated shots reuse GPU assets and keep the garden free of trajectory and route lines
Score reset and scene changes clear aim safely; no browser errors or warnings
